info.title: E-commerce API
info.description: Machine-readable contract of the approved e-commerce API specs. The human-readable specs under e-commerce/doc/api are the source of behaviour; every operation names its spec in x-spec. Regenerate with .agents/skills/api-contract-design/scripts/gen_contract.py.

post.description:
Set a new password with the reset token from the reset email, The reset token can be used once and expires 30 minutes after the request, All access tokens and refresh tokens of the user are closed, The user must log in again

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/authen-and-author/04-create-new-password/spec.md`

resetToken.description: Reset token from the link of the reset email

newPassword.description: New password, Plain text over TLS (8 to 128 characters, an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter and a digit), Must differ from the current password

status.bizMessage: Reset Token and New Password are required fields.
Password must be 8 to 128 characters and contain an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter and a digit.
Reset token is invalid or expired.
New password must be different from the current password.
The server timed out waiting for the request.

post.description:
Authenticate a user by username or email address and password, load active roles, permissions and scopes, record the session and issue an access token and a refresh token, A username that failed 5 times in 15 minutes is refused for a while with the same answer as a wrong password

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/authen-and-author/02-login/spec.md`

username.description: Username or email address, Plain text over TLS, The system encrypts it before it is compared

refreshAccessToken.description: Refresh Token, Expiring 14 days after it is issued, Can be used once (see the refresh token API)

status.bizMessage: Username and Password are required fields.
The server timed out waiting for the request.

post.description:
Log out of the current session, Every access token and refresh token of the same session is closed at once, Other sessions of the user are not changed

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/authen-and-author/06-logout/spec.md`

status.bizMessage: Timestamp must be a valid UTC timestamp and the request body must be empty.
The server timed out waiting for the request.

post.description:
Exchange one refresh token for fresh access/refresh tokens and current permission-specific claims; preserve the session, reject a recent duplicate, and revoke the session on older replay

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/authen-and-author/05-refresh-token/spec.md`

refreshAccessToken.description: Refresh token from login or from the last refresh

accessToken.description: Access Token (JWT), Valid for expiresIn seconds

refreshAccessToken.description: Refresh Token, Expiring 14 days after it is issued, Can be used once

status.bizMessage: Refresh Access Token is a required field.
The server timed out waiting for the request.

post.description:
Register a new user with username, email address and password, together with personal information, addresses, consents and referrer

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/authen-and-author/01-register/spec.md`

username.description: Username (max 128 characters), Plain text over TLS, The system encrypts it before it is stored, It can be the email address

emailAddress.description: Email address (max 254 characters), Plain text over TLS, The system encrypts it before it is stored

password.description: Password, Plain text over TLS, 8 to 128 characters with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter and a digit, Stored as a salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hash

firstName.description: First name (max 100 characters), Plain text over TLS, The system encrypts it before it is stored

lastName.description: Last name (max 100 characters), Plain text over TLS, The system encrypts it before it is stored

isDefault.description: Default address, The first address of a user is always the default address

consents.description: Displayed consents; required current consents must all be included and accepted

consentVersion.description: The displayed version (max 8 characters); must match the current version; never defaulted

result.description: Explicit answer; omission records reading only, stored as false for this new row. Required consent needs explicit true

status.bizMessage: Username, Email Address and Password are required fields.
Password must be 8 to 128 characters and contain an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter and a digit.
Consent version is no longer current.
All current required consents must be accepted.
The server timed out waiting for the request.
Username or email address already exists.

post.description:
Request a password reset, The answer is always the same whether or not the email address is registered, A reset link with a single use token that expires in 30 minutes is sent to a registered and ACTIVE user, At most 3 requests per user per hour

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/authen-and-author/03-reset-password/spec.md`

emailAddress.description: Email address of the account, Plain text over TLS, The system encrypts it before it is compared (max 254 characters)

status.bizMessage: If the email address is registered, a reset link has been sent.
Email Address is required and must be a valid email address.
The server timed out waiting for the request.

isPlatformAdmin.description: TRUE when the caller has the role PLATFORM_ADMIN

status.bizMessage: Timestamp is a required header and must be a valid UTC timestamp.

post.description:
Insert, update or delete a permission, only a platform administrator can call it, Insert when id is not specified, Update when id is specified, Delete when rowStatus is DELETED (HTTP 204 No Content, no response body), Archive when rowStatus is ARCHIVED (HTTP 200)

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/author/04-upsert-permission/spec.md`

id.description: Permission Id, Insert when not specified, Update, Delete or Archive when specified, The id of a DELETED permission counts as not found

name.description: Permission Name, Permission code (max 64 characters): lower-case letters, digits, `_` and `.`, at least two parts, Unique among permissions that are not DELETED

scopes.description: Scopes of the permission, Each item is inserted when `id` is not specified, updated when `id` is specified, deleted when `rowStatus` is DELETED, Scopes that are not listed are kept

id.description: Permission Scope Id, Insert when not specified, Update or Delete when specified, Must belong to this permission and must not be duplicated

scopeId.description: Scope Id, ACTIVE master required for an ACTIVE link (404 E10005), Existing DELETED-link requests may reference a closed master (Q23), Immutable when id is specified, No duplicate scope among non-DELETED input items

rowStatus.description: Row status (ACTIVE, DELETED), Defaults to ACTIVE, Delete when DELETED (not allowed when inserting), A scope that a role or user still uses cannot be deleted

Row status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DELETED, LOCKED, ARCHIVED), Defaults to ACTIVE, Delete when DELETED, Archive when ARCHIVED, DELETED is not allowed when inserting, Delete/archive requires no role/user usage; Delete also requires zero final non-DELETED scope definitions (Q24)

permissionId.description: Inserted, Updated or Archived Permission Id, Not returned when deleted (HTTP 204)
Inserted, Updated or Archived Permission Id, Not returned when deleted (HTTP 204)

status.bizMessage: Name and Description are required fields.
Permission name must be lower-case letters, digits, _ and ., with at least two parts separated by a dot, at most 64 characters.
Row status must not be DELETED when inserting a permission.
You do not have permission to manage permissions.
The server timed out waiting for the request.
Permission is used by roles or users.
Scope is used by roles or users.
Scope already exists in the permission.
Permission cannot become unscoped while assigned to roles or users.
Permission cannot be deleted while scope definitions remain.

post.description:
Insert, update or delete multiple permissions at the same time, only a platform administrator can call it, Each permission is inserted when id is not specified, updated when id is specified, deleted when rowStatus is DELETED, archived when rowStatus is ARCHIVED, The response is always HTTP 200 for a successful batch including when it deletes (each result is reported in the body with its action), All permissions are processed in one transaction in the request order, If any permission fails then no permission is changed

Source spec: `e-commerce/doc/api/author/05-upsert-permission-batch/spec.md`

permissions.description: Permissions to insert, update or delete (min 1, max 100 items)

id.description: Permission Id, Insert when not specified, Update, Delete or Archive when specified, The id of a DELETED permission counts as not found, Must not be duplicated in the request

name.description: Permission Name, Permission code (max 64 characters): lower-case letters, digits, `_` and `.`, at least two parts, Unique among permissions that are not DELETED

scopes.description: Scopes of the permission, same rules as the single upsert

id.description: Permission Scope Id, Insert when not specified, Update or Delete when specified, Must belong to this permission and must not be duplicated

scopeId.description: Scope Id, ACTIVE master required only for ACTIVE links (404 E10005), An owned existing link to a closed master can be removed (Q23), Immutable when id is specified, No duplicate scope among non-DELETED input items

rowStatus.description: Row status (ACTIVE, DELETED), Defaults to ACTIVE, Delete when DELETED (not allowed when inserting), A scope that a role or user still uses cannot be deleted

Row status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DELETED, LOCKED, ARCHIVED), Defaults to ACTIVE, Delete when DELETED, Archive when ARCHIVED, DELETED is not allowed when inserting, Delete requires zero final non-DELETED scope definitions (Q24)

permissions.description: Result of each permission, Same order as the request

index.description: Index of the permission in the request, Starting from 0

permissionId.description: Inserted, Updated, Deleted or Archived Permission Id

action.description: Action of the permission (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, ARCHIVE)

status.bizMessage: permissions[0]: Name and Description are required fields.
permissions[1]: Permission name must be lower-case letters, digits, _ and ., with at least two parts separated by a dot, at most 64 characters.
permissions[1]: Row status must not be DELETED when inserting a permission.
permissions[2]: Id is duplicated with permissions[1].
permissions[2]: Name is duplicated with permissions[0].
permissions[1]: Scope Id cannot be changed.
You do not have permission to manage permissions.
The server timed out waiting for the request.
permissions[2]: Permission is used by roles or users.
permissions[0]: Scope is used by roles or users.
permissions[1]: Scope already exists in the permission.
permissions[1]: Permission cannot become unscoped while assigned to roles or users.
